custodyDesc: Track employee assignments and the status of every asset.

wf.intro: Record cash and physical custody, employee purchases and returns.
wf.demoRoleHint: Local demo: switch between manager and employee views to try the workflow. This is not real sign-in or authorization.
wf.storageError: Local data could not be read or saved. Current changes may be session-only; resolve storage before relying on them.
wf.noInventory: No available units. Register a unit in inventory first.
wf.name: Asset name / model
wf.returnMoneyHint: Record money actually received back from the employee, with evidence reference.
wf.reimburseHint: Approved overspend: record reimbursement actually paid to the employee and its reference. Reimbursement is not automatic.
wf.issueHint: Custody remains unresolved until the manager records the damage or loss resolution; clearance is blocked.
wf.attachmentHint: PDF, PNG or JPG, up to 2 files, maximum 1 MB each. Attachments are stored only in this browser.
wf.invoiceHint: Attach invoices with purchases. Before closure, provide evidence or a missing-invoice explanation.
wf.overspend: Spending exceeds the advance. The difference remains recorded; closure does not record reimbursement.
wf.balanceHint: Remaining = advance − spending − returned amount. A negative value means spending exceeded the advance.

events.managerClosed: Manager recorded receipt and closed custody

errors.permission: This action is not allowed for the current actor.
errors.phase: Action is unavailable in this custody phase.
errors.invalidEmployee: Choose an active employee without issued clearance.
errors.inventoryUnavailable: Asset is unavailable or already reserved.
errors.dateRange: Check dates and amounts; purchase must be between issue date and today.
errors.lockedPurchase: Expense is approved or not editable now.
errors.invoiceRequired: Attach an invoice or provide a missing-invoice explanation for every expense before submission.
errors.reviewPending: Review all expenses first and return corrections to the employee.
errors.settlementAmount: Returned amount must match the positive remainder; enter zero when spending exceeds the advance.
errors.unsettled: Resolve all expense reviews and settle the balance before closure.
errors.attachmentInvalid: Choose a valid PDF, PNG or JPG up to 1 MB.
errors.invalid: Action failed; review the entered values and current state.
errors.duplicateInvoice: This invoice is already recorded for the custody.

results.good: Asset and accessories received in good condition
results.issue: Damage, missing items or loss requires resolution
results.writtenOff: Approve asset write-off after documented resolution

wf.closeHint: Record the amount actually received from the employee. Any positive remainder must be received in full before closure.
wf.amountMissing: This custody has no recorded amount. Enter it to track spending and the remaining balance.
